Bundled browser libraries, copied from npm (source-map comments removed) so the app needs no build step:

- `smplr.mjs`: [smplr](https://github.com/danigb/smplr) 1.0.1 (`dist/index.mjs`), MIT. Instrument samples are fetched from its sample hosts on first use.
- `opensheetmusicdisplay.min.js`: [OpenSheetMusicDisplay](https://github.com/opensheetmusicdisplay/opensheetmusicdisplay) 2.2.0, BSD-3-Clause (see `opensheetmusicdisplay.LICENSE`).
